Diwali is a time for sweets, mithai and delicious snacks. But are homemade sweets always healthy? Is jaggery a better option than refined sugar? The truth is that ingredients, preparation methods and portion sizes all matter.
In this video, Hansaji shares five easy homemade sattvik recipes that allow you to enjoy festive flavours while being mindful of added sugar, excess fat and deep-frying.
Five healthy Diwali recipes covered in this video:
1. Ragi, Sesame and Peanut Bites – A combination of ragi, roasted peanuts, sesame seeds and jaggery.
